aboutUs.label: About Us
aboutUs.heading: See the Land Through Eyes of Love
aboutUs.text2: experiential tourism and education company, headquartered at Batchewana First Nation in Bawaating (Sault Ste. Marie, Ontario, Canada). Haudenosaunee-led and working in respectful partnership with Anishinaabe Knowledge Carriers on whose territory it operates, Thrive Tours is among Canada's most recognized Indigenous tourism companies, honoured for sustainability at the international, national, and provincial levels.
aboutUs.text3: Our expert guides are highly trained and knowledgeable, focusing on our Indigenous teachings and traditions, to offer an unforgettable journey of discovery and appreciation for Mother Earth, each other, and how we are all connected.
aboutUs.text4: Our guided tours are crafted to showcase the natural beauty and historical significance of the local area, including hiking, canoeing, kayaking, snowshoeing, storytelling, Indigenous Food Sharing, and Cultural Workshops including Indigenous Art.

leadership.label: Leadership
leadership.heading: Thrive Team
leadership.text: Guided by the shared values of respect, sustainability, and cultural integrity

bradRobinson.text2: Brad Robinson is the CEO of Thrive Tours and a Haudenosaunee leader from Oneida Nation of the Thames. Under his leadership, Thrive Tours earned sustainability recognition at every level in 2025, internationally from the Indigenous Tourism Association of Canada and, weeks apart, provincially and nationally with the Sustainable Tourism Award from the Tourism Industry Association of Ontario and the Tourism Industry Association of Canada. In 2026, Thrive Tours was named a Sustainable Tourism Global Winner for Authenticity and Eco Adventure at Global Islands: Leading Beyond 2030 in Madeira, Portugal.
bradRobinson.text3: As CROP 2026's Canadian anchor partner and Cultural Programming Lead, Brad brings two decades of Indigenous tourism and facilitation work to the gathering.
bradRobinson.label: Bachelor's Degree in Native Studies, Laurentian University
bradRobinson.label2: Law and Security Administration Diploma, Cambrian College
bradRobinson.label3: Talented Indigenous artist: video, photography, graphic design, traditional drumming

roleInCrop2026.label: Conference
roleInCrop2026.heading: Our Role in CROP 2026
roleInCrop2026.text: As a co-organizer of the CROP 2026 Conference, Thrive Tours brings its unique expertise in Indigenous eco-cultural tourism and land-based education to enrich the conference experience. We are committed to demonstrating how cultural resilience and sustainable practices can be integrated into meaningful experiences that honor Indigenous knowledge and traditions.
roleInCrop2026.text2: Our role includes facilitating cultural immersion experiences, leading workshops on Indigenous knowledge systems and land stewardship, and sharing our model of community-based tourism as a pathway to economic resilience. We believe that experiencing nature through Indigenous eyes is a powerful catalyst for understanding and action. Through CROP 2026, we aim to inspire delegates to see the world through eyes of love and to carry that perspective back to their own communities and work.

items.title: Small Groups
items.desc: Want a different sort of adventure with your friends or family. A guided trip into the wilderness is an excellent way to bond. We adapt the trip program to your group's individual needs, ages, and abilities.

items.title: Activity Tours
items.desc: Thrive Tours offers Authentic Indigenous year-round land-based experiences in Northern Ontario in the Algoma, Sault Ste. Marie (Baawaating) region like kayaking, canoeing, hiking, snowshoeing and more.

items.title: Highlights
items.desc: Grab your camera! There are so many highlights on one of these tours, you'll want to capture them all. Better yet, join our Paint and Paddle Tour and we will provide supplies to create your own piece!

items.title: Custom Tours
items.desc: If you have something in mind that isn't described in these pages, just let us know, and we'll do our best to create a personalized outdoor workshop or team building experience for your group.

items2.title: Indigenous Guided Hikes
items2.desc: Experience the beauty of the land with our interpretive hiking tours led by Indigenous guides. Immerse yourself in nature and learn about the rich cultural history and teachings of the area. Our tours vary in length and difficulty to accommodate all skill levels.

items2.title: Paddle & Learn Kayak/Canoe Tour
items2.desc: Explore the waterways of Baawaating (Sault Ste. Marie) with our guided kayaking and canoeing tours. From the calm waters of the river to the rugged shores of Lake Superior, our experienced guides will take you on an unforgettable journey.

items2.title: Custom Tours & Multi-Day Experiences
items2.desc: Let us create a personalized outdoor workshop or team building experience for your group. We can tailor our tours to meet your specific needs and interests, whether it's culture, leadership, or team development. Multi-day experiences available.

items3.text: Amanda and Brad are truly special people that help you see the land through eyes of love. Our tour experience with Thrive was unforgettable — every moment served as a gentle reminder to slow down and take time to consider all the life that surrounds us.
